items.title: Payno
items.shortDescription: Premium personal finance dashboard with sleek charts, financial cards, and glass panels.
items.description: Payno is a premium personal finance dashboard that helps users track spending, savings, and investments through an elegant glassmorphic interface.
items.problem: Users struggled to visualize finances across fragmented banking apps with outdated, cluttered interfaces.
items.solution: We designed and built a unified finance dashboard with real-time charts, smart categorization, and glass UI components.

items.title: EduSmart
items.shortDescription: Automated education ecosystem with dynamic quiz results, data views, and student progress tracking.
items.description: EduSmart is an automated education platform connecting teachers, students, and administrators through quizzes, analytics, and progress dashboards.
items.problem: Educational institutions lacked a unified platform for quizzes, grading, and progress analytics across online and offline learning.
items.solution: We built an end-to-end EdTech ecosystem with automated quiz grading, student dashboards, and real-time performance tracking.

items.title: Dental CRM
items.shortDescription: A specialized CRM for dental clinics — patient, appointment, and treatment history management.
items.description: A CRM system specialized for dentistry. Patient records, appointment scheduling, treatment plans, and financial reports.
items.problem: The clinic kept patient records on paper and booked appointments by phone. No-show rates were high.
items.solution: A specialized dental CRM was built — online booking, automatic reminders, and complete patient history.

items.title: Connecta CRM
items.shortDescription: CRM for sales and service companies — lead, deal, and team management.
items.description: Connecta CRM is built for B2B sales companies. Lead tracking, sales pipeline, team KPIs, and integrations.
items.problem: The sales team tracked leads in Excel and deal status was unclear. Managers couldn't see progress in real time.
items.solution: A sales-focused CRM platform was created — pipeline visualization, automatic lead assignment, and KPI dashboard.
results: Managers see progress in real time

items.title: E-commerce Platform
items.shortDescription: A fully functional online store — product catalog, payment, and delivery integration.
items.description: A modern e-commerce platform — 1000+ products, multiple payment methods, admin panel, and analytics dashboard.
items.problem: The business sold only offline with no online channel. Competitors had already captured the online market.
items.solution: A fully functional online store was built — integrated with Uzbekistan payment systems and delivery tracking.

items.title: Telegram Booking System
items.shortDescription: Service booking via Telegram — automatic reminders and payment integration.
items.description: Service booking through a Telegram Mini App and bot. For restaurants, salons, and service businesses.
items.problem: Customers booked by phone and operators spent significant time. No-show and double booking were common.
items.solution: A Telegram Mini App was created — online booking, automatic confirmation, reminders, and payment options.

items.title: Logistics Dashboard
items.shortDescription: Real-time tracking dashboard for a logistics company — delivery and fleet management.
items.description: A platform for monitoring logistics operations in real time. Fleet, routes, delivery status, and analytics.
items.problem: Logistics operations were managed by phone and radio with no real-time data.
items.solution: A real-time tracking dashboard was built — GPS integration, route optimization, and automatic notifications.

items.title: FinTech Mobile App
items.shortDescription: Mobile app for financial services — payments, balance, and transaction management.
items.description: A modern FinTech mobile app — secure payments, balance monitoring, transaction history, and push notifications.
items.problem: Customers could only perform financial operations at the office or on the website. Mobile convenience was required.
items.solution: A secure, fast mobile app was built — biometric authentication, real-time balance, and payment capabilities.

faq.question: How long does a project take to complete?
faq.answer: Timeline depends on complexity. A simple landing page — 2–4 weeks, corporate website — 4–8 weeks, CRM or complex web app — 8–16 weeks. We set an exact timeline after discussing project requirements.

faq.question: How is website pricing determined?
faq.answer: Pricing depends on project scope, number of features, design complexity, and integrations. We provide a free consultation and detailed estimate. Final price is agreed before signing the contract.

faq.question: Do you provide website maintenance?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer technical support for all our projects. Hosting monitoring, updates, security patches, and rapid issue resolution — available 24/7.

faq.question: Is a mobile version also developed?
faq.answer: Absolutely. All our websites are built with responsive design — they look great on phones, tablets, and desktops. We can also develop a dedicated mobile app.

faq.question: Can you build a CRM system?
faq.answer: Yes, CRM and ERP systems are one of our core specialties. We build custom systems for managing customers, orders, staff, and reports. VITA CRM — our ready-made solution — is also available.

faq.question: Can new features be added later?
faq.answer: Yes, all projects are built with an architecture designed for expansion. Adding new features, modules, and integrations is easy and fast.

faq.question: How is payment handled?
faq.answer: Standard payment plan: 30% upfront (on contract signing), 40% during development (midpoint), 30% on project delivery. Payment by bank transfer or cash is accepted.
